name: Gel Pens (Set of 5)
description: Smooth 0.5 mm gel pens in five campus colours. The ink dries quickly, so notes stay clean even when you close the book in a hurry.

name: Spiral Notebook
description: A 160-page ruled spiral notebook with a firm cover. It lies flat on a desk, which makes long lectures easier to follow.

name: Scientific Calculator
description: A non-programmable scientific calculator for class tests and board exams. Fractions, trigonometry and statistics are one key away.

name: File Folders (Pack of 5)
description: Five sturdy A4 folders for assignments, printouts and lab sheets. Colour-code a subject and stop digging through a loose stack.

name: Highlighters (Set of 4)
description: Chisel-tip highlighters in four soft shades that do not bleed through textbook paper. Useful for revision maps and formula boxes.

name: Lab Record Book
description: A bound practical record with index pages, observation tables and blank sheets for diagrams. Made for physics, chemistry and biology labs.

name: Drawing Kit
description: Pencils, ruler, compass and eraser in one kit for engineering graphics and art class. The case keeps the small pieces together.

name: Sticky Notes (Pack of 6)
description: Six pads of repositionable notes for formulas, to-do lists and page markers. They lift cleanly off most textbook pages.

name: HB Pencils (Pack of 12)
description: A dozen bonded HB pencils with a clean graphite core. They sharpen evenly and suit both classwork and bubble-sheet exams.

name: Watercolour Set
description: Twelve watercolour cakes with a round brush for posters, charts and art portfolios. Colours mix cleanly on ordinary cartridge paper.

name: Geometry Box
description: Compass, divider, set squares, protractor and pencil in a hinged metal box. The latch keeps everything in the bag between periods.

name: Campus Backpack
description: A padded laptop sleeve, bottle pocket and room for a full day's books. The back panel is cushioned for the walk between blocks.

name: A4 Binder Set
description: Two ring binders with punched pockets for handouts you still need next semester. Labels on the spine make a shelf easy to scan.

name: Sketchbook A4
description: Thick, lightly toothed paper that takes pencil, ink and light watercolour. Eighty sheets, stitched so pages do not fall out.

name: Graph Notebook
description: 1 cm graph ruling for plots, circuits and accounting tables. Margins are wide enough for a teacher's remarks.

name: Campus Fountain Pen
description: A smooth medium nib for journals and assignment titles. The converter works with standard bottled ink from the campus store.

name: Index Dividers
description: Ten writable tabs that split a binder by subject or experiment. The card is stiff enough to flip quickly in a viva file.

name: Practical Log Book
description: Numbered pages for aim, apparatus, observation and result. A staff-signature box sits at the foot of every experiment.

name: Brush Marker Set
description: Dual-tip markers for posters, titles and project covers. One end writes a fine line and the other fills a broad stroke.

name: Basic Calculator
description: A clear 12-digit desk calculator for accounts, statistics tables and quick checks. Solar and battery power keep it ready in class.

name: Exam Writing Pad
description: Forty ruled sheets, punched and light enough for a test booklet. The header leaves space for name, roll number and date.

name: Pencil Case
description: A zip pouch that holds pens, a sharpener and a short ruler without crowding the backpack. The lining is easy to wipe clean.
